hazards.description: A 'Sidewalk Closed' sign and traffic cone indicate the walkway is blocked ahead, which may force pedestrians to walk in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the sidewalk, near the building with large windows.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing via Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Repurpose the wide shoulders or excess lane width to create marked bike lanes, which narrows the travel lanes and provides an additional buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island at a new crossing point to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance across the roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a buffer zone with street trees or planters between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard transverse lines with continental markings to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Fill and level the missing pavement section to restore a continuous, hazard-free walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically for the sidewalk to improve visibility and safety at night, especially given the blank frontage of the parking lot.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, paved, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide a safe and accessible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Installation
interventions.description: Install concrete curbs to provide vertical separation between the roadway and the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and safety for all road users at night.

interventions.title: Install Near-Side Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Street Lighting and Greenery

interventions.title: Street Furniture and Activation
interventions.description: Add benches or waste receptacles to utilize the wide sidewalk space and encourage maintenance.

interventions.title: Tree Pit Grates or Permeable Paving
interventions.description: Install flush tree grates or permeable pavers around the tree base to provide a continuous walking surface while protecting the tree.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical deflection to slow traffic in this residential/commercial mixed zone.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk with a raised curb to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic and parking areas.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially with a pedestrian refuge island and RRFBs, to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to complete the pedestrian network and provide a safe path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the broken and fragmented pavement with a continuous, ADA-compliant concrete surface.

interventions.title: Curb Extension / Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway (curb extension) to provide a clear walking path around the existing mature tree without sacrificing pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and personal security along the blank frontage.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow traffic and provide space for other amenities like bike lanes.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to improve connectivity and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Protection
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width and install a raised curb with a furniture or planting zone to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Physical Barriers
interventions.description: Install bollards or high curbs to prevent vehicles from encroaching on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow existing lanes to include a center turn lane or median and dedicated bike lanes.

interventions.title: Curb and Sidewalk Construction

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk with appropriate signage and potentially a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
